mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (as of the most recent month) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE has increased by >0.3pp in the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in nonfarm payrolls (both as of the most recent month) signals a severe labor market contraction, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary tightening, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL is above 3.0% YoY, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (as of the most recent month) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below the 100 index level (base 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate output and earnings, and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (both above their 3-month moving averages) signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods where both inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% year-over-year and the federal funds rate is above 4.0%, the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, FEDFUNDS > 4.0%)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months meeting the regime condition, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.
